category_edits.rationale: Shorten uniform causal pooling from four observed states to two across all four category models to emphasize immediate intent. Preserve the 0.8 current-state/0.2 pooled-state blend, nonpadding normalization, final-real-position readout, and all other model and training settings. Training and inference share the modified encoder; update checkpoint metadata and predictor validation consistently.

response.change_summary: Use two-state causal readout pooling for every category and synchronize checkpoint metadata with the embedded predictor writer.
